metadata.title: Modern Python Flask API Development
metadata.description: A comprehensive mastery roadmap covering Python foundations, HTTP/REST, Flask core, request handling, databases, authentication, API design, testing, background tasks, security, deployment, performance, and advanced architectural patterns.

sections.title: Foundations
sections.description: Python language fundamentals and HTTP/REST protocol knowledge required before Flask development.

sections.title: Flask Core
sections.description: Core Flask framework concepts: application factory, routing, blueprints, contexts, and configuration.

sections.title: API Development
sections.description: Building robust APIs with request validation, database integration, authentication, documentation, and testing.

sections.title: Production Engineering
sections.description: Production-grade concerns: background tasks, security hardening, deployment, and observability.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.description: Expert-level architectural patterns for complex Flask-based systems.
